name: Helpdesk
description: A support team's tickets, statuses, priorities and assigned teams.
hints: Statuses: Open, In Progress, Waiting on Customer (all open) and Resolved, Closed (not open). ticket_statuses.is_open tells whether a status counts as open. Priorities: Low, Medium, High, Critical; 'high-priority' normally means High or Critical. Requester emails are not accessible.

ticket_statuses.description: Ticket statuses and whether they are open.

priorities.description: Priority levels; higher rank_order = more urgent.

reports.name: open_tickets_by_priority
reports.description: Number of open tickets per priority

examples: How many tickets does each team have open?
Which tickets were created in the last 7 days?
